why: Both celebration of the finished work and the room's running jokes appear together, and the boundary between a celebratory post and an in-joke is thin.

why.T3-070: Concepts post templates, blueprints, mock-ups and plans for placers to reproduce; not T3-091 because no one plan is imposed against rivals, and not T3-004 because the design is shared as directions.

why.T3-014: Concepts set up and send members to Discord for planning; T3-014 rather than T3-028 because the main labour is the chat move.
why.T3-028: Scripts and bots are shared/run for placement; T3-028 rather than T3-014 because this is automated placement, not chat.
why.T3-152: Concepts relay Discord decisions back to the thread; T3-152 rather than T3-014 because the report itself is the act.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-014's chat-move gate does not reach running scripts or bots for placement.

multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-028 if forced; lose the automated placement aspect.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-014's gate covers moving to chat, not bringing chat decisions back to the thread.

multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-152 if forced; lose the relay of chat decisions.

why.T3-073: Concepts ask what happened, take stock, recount repairs and final changes; T3-073 rather than T3-009 because the through-line is reporting the work's state, not simply celebrating.

why.T3-005: Concepts sound alarms and call comrades to defend against attacks; T3-005 rather than T3-087 because the warnings aim at rallying defence, not only tracing the source.

why.T3-041: Concepts add and propose further CT sprites to the existing cast; T3-041 rather than T3-038 because the theme is building out the cast piece by piece, not reporting one build's progress.

why.T3-105: Concepts clean and preserve the final canvas as a record; T3-105 rather than T3-112 because this is a cleaned final image, not an atlas entry.

why.T3-016: Concepts teach controls, cooldowns and canvas mechanics; T3-016 rather than T3-074 because the point is learning/explaining how the canvas works, not working around the timer to build.

why.T3-111: Concepts ask what the r/place sub should become after the canvas; T3-111 rather than T3-157 because the subject is the sub's future purpose, not reflection on cooperation.

why.T3-121: Concepts report abusive placers to mods and secure bans/exclusions; T3-121 rather than T3-063 because the action is sanctioning vandals, not removing posts under standing rules.

why.T3-009: Concepts celebrate the finished fight and left unity as achieved; T3-009 rather than T3-031 because the leading act is celebration of the work.
why.T3-031: Concepts play the room's running jokes and catchphrases; T3-031 rather than T3-009 because these are in-jokes, not the achievement itself.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009's achievement gate does not carry the room's recurring jokes and memes.

multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-031 if forced; lose the joke and meme layer.

why.T3-016: Concepts ask and explain what r/place is and why it exists as an April Fools event; T3-016 rather than T3-048 because the explanation is of the canvas event itself.

why.T3-069: Concepts drop fragile CCCP/text/BLM/Aku pieces to concentrate pixels elsewhere; T3-069 rather than T3-042 because specific pieces are abandoned for one priority, not just upkeep over expansion.

why.T3-054: Concepts invite members to successor sites and rebuild the pixel fight there; T3-054 rather than T3-057 because the move is to another canvas, not another medium.

why.T3-121: Concepts report abusive placers to mods and secure bans/exclusions; T3-121 rather than T3-063 because the action is sanctioning vandals, not removing posts under standing rules.

why.T3-027: Concepts debate whether scripts are moral, in the spirit, or the people's tool; T3-027 rather than T3-028 because the through-line is argument over fairness, not simply running the script.
